title: Investigating Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems on Unanswerable, Uncheatable, Realistic, Multi-hop Queries
authors: Gabrielle Kaili-May Liu; Bryan Li; Arman Cohan; William Gantt Walden; Eugene Yang
why_relevant: Introduces a benchmark pipeline for unanswerable, multi-hop RAG queries, testing systems' ability to reject out-of-scope queries and identify retrieval/reasoning failures—directly relevant to OOD/uncertainty and evaluation under unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on benchmark construction rather than methods for robustness or calibration.
